title: Delegated autonomy needs complete facts and editable accepted scope
summary: Preserve authority facts and every declared delegation field across human approval and amendments.
reusable_steps: Preserve authority facts and every declared delegation field across human approval and amendments
expected_outcome: A delegated allow requires the authorized role and valid facts for its declared metric. Missing or unknown facts require escalation. A charter is both a grant and a limit; preserve recipient and processor scope and risk ceilings when amending it, and invalidate consent whenever the draft changes. Keep observation tuning separate from signed authority. Verify direct actuator calls as well as dispatch and use independent review to refute bypasses.
